_about: INVENTED DATA for a book example. MLR-approved content items, copied from Example C1 so both examples tell the same story. Brands Zentivra and Lumotrex are fictional.

items.text: In the pivotal trial, Zentivra reduced the risk of heart failure hospitalization versus placebo. See full Prescribing Information.
Zentivra is taken once daily. Titrate per the Prescribing Information based on tolerability and renal function.
Lumotrex improved lung function at week 12 versus placebo in adults with moderate to severe asthma. See full Prescribing Information.
